locationScope: Shepherd’s Glen Police Station, Alex’s closed cell before release by Wheeler
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE standalone transparent RGBA foreground overlay for a 2D side-view fighting game, matching a native 1672 by 941 wide 16:9 canvas.
Input image 1 is the finished background plate supplied ONLY as a camera, material, color and lighting reference. DO NOT copy that background; DO NOT include its floor, back wall or scene. Create an independent sparse near-parallax layer. Genuine transparency, no painted checkerboard, no solid backdrop, no full-canvas semi-transparent wash or vignette.
Keep ALL visible artwork restricted to the outermost 3.5 percent of the left and right canvas edges. Every pixel of the central 90 percent (x=0.05 to x=0.95), over the full canvas height, must be perfectly transparent alpha 0. At least 93 percent of the overall canvas must be fully transparent. No object, dust, shadow, texture, reflection, glow or translucent pixel across the center. The bottom fighting-floor lane must remain clear everywhere except tiny far outer corners. No continuous floor strip. Match exact horizontal side-view camera and subdued light.
Only two extremely narrow dark gray concrete jamb edge slivers cropped by the left and right canvas boundaries, with tiny chipped dull steel fastener edge at the far upper left. A minute flat gray concrete chip may touch the extreme bottom right corner. Use realistic restrained worn materials matching the police cell. Do not include jail bars crossing the scene, a gate, a wall plane, any lock, corridor, floor, weapon, person, monster, blood, flesh, writing or new object. Keep the actual strips irregular and almost entirely off-canvas; nothing extends beyond x=0.035 at left or before x=0.965 at right.
No text, UI, logo, watermark, frame or collage. Deliver only this sparse transparent overlay.
